llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究选择性激光熔化中的熔道不连续性，不涉及生物医学材料或植入物相关方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on process physics of SLM melt track discontinuity, without any biomedical material, porous structure, stress shielding, mechanical testing, or osseointegration context.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析SLM中悬垂熔道的不连续性成因
summary_zh.method: 通过热-流耦合模型模拟熔道形成过程
summary_zh.result: 揭示了熔道不连续性由热毛细力和重力共同导致
summary_zh.validation: 基于数值模拟与文献实验对比

summary_en.motivation: To understand the mechanism of melt track discontinuity in overhanging structures during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A coupled thermal-fluid flow model is developed to simulate the melt track formation.
summary_en.result: The discontinuity is driven by Marangoni convection and gravitational effects under overhang conditions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical predictions are compared with experimental observations from the literature.
